name: pitwright
description: Tooling for running Claude Code at scale: subagent spawn guards and parallel-session coordination today; delegation economics and context-pressure hooks to follow.

plugins.name: spawn-guards
plugins.description: Enforce a per-agent model-tier floor on subagent spawns, and flag delegation prompts that reference context the subagent cannot see.

plugins.name: coord
plugins.description: Coordinate several Claude Code sessions in one repository: edit-time file locks, a session board, an addressed peer mailbox, merge-collision warnings across worktrees, and a closeout ledger.
